fullTextZH: 你好！
fullTextEN: Hello!

fullTextZH: 你知道现在我是一个老师，
fullTextEN: You know, now I am a teacher,

fullTextZH: 对，我教中文。
fullTextEN: Yes, I teach Chinese.

fullTextZH: 那你觉得，以前我是一个好学生吗？
fullTextEN: So, do you think I was a good student before?

fullTextZH: 还是一个很叛逆的（rebellious）学生？
fullTextEN: Or a very rebellious student?

fullTextZH: 我觉得我算是一个好学生，
fullTextEN: I think I was a good student,

fullTextZH: 也算是一个很叛逆的学生。
fullTextEN: and also a very rebellious student.

fullTextZH: 但是我的叛逆，不是去做很奇怪的发型，
fullTextEN: But my rebellion wasn't about having strange hairstyles,

fullTextZH: 不是去戴很多耳钉、鼻钉，
fullTextEN: not about wearing many earrings or nose rings,

fullTextZH: 不是、不是去打架，
fullTextEN: not, not about fighting,

fullTextZH: 不是这样的叛逆。
fullTextEN: not that kind of rebellion.

fullTextZH: 好，以前我觉得，如果我喜欢一个老师，
fullTextEN: Okay, before I thought, if I liked a teacher,

fullTextZH: 那我可能是一个好学生；
fullTextEN: then I might be a good student;

fullTextZH: 如果我不喜欢一个老师，
fullTextEN: if I didn't like a teacher,

fullTextZH: 那我可能是一个不好的学生。
fullTextEN: then I might be a bad student.

fullTextZH: 我当学生的时候，我真的不怕我的老师，
fullTextEN: When I was a student, I really wasn't afraid of my teachers,

fullTextZH: 我觉得老师也有可能是错的。
fullTextEN: I thought teachers could also be wrong.

fullTextZH: 所以，如果我发现他们说错，
fullTextEN: So, if I found they were wrong,

fullTextZH: 我会直接说：“老师，这个不对，
fullTextEN: I would directly say: 'Teacher, this is not right,

fullTextZH: 应该是这个、这个。”
fullTextEN: it should be this, this.'

fullTextZH: 对，我觉得那个时候，我真的不怕权威（authority），
fullTextEN: Yes, I think at that time, I really wasn't afraid of authority,

fullTextZH: 我也不怕老师会生气。
fullTextEN: I also wasn't afraid that the teacher would get angry.

fullTextZH: 那以前，我在中文课和英语课比较自信，
fullTextEN: Back then, I was more confident in Chinese and English classes,

fullTextZH: 我觉得我懂得很多。
fullTextEN: I felt I understood a lot.

fullTextZH: 如果我觉得我的老师说的不对，
fullTextEN: If I thought my teacher was wrong,

fullTextZH: 我会直接告诉他。
fullTextEN: I would directly tell him.

fullTextZH: 可能有的老师会觉得没有面子，
fullTextEN: Some teachers might feel embarrassed,

fullTextZH: 有一点点丢脸，
fullTextEN: a little bit ashamed,

fullTextZH: 但是没有一个老师真的生我的气。
fullTextEN: but no teacher really got angry with me.

fullTextZH: 嗯，有可能他们心里很生气，
fullTextEN: Hmm, maybe they were very angry inside,

fullTextZH: 但是他们没有表现出来。
fullTextEN: but they didn't show it.

fullTextZH: 我觉得是因为我很认真，
fullTextEN: I think it's because I was very serious,

fullTextZH: 所以我才发现了他们的错误，
fullTextEN: so I discovered their mistakes,

fullTextZH: 所以我觉得他们不应该生气。
fullTextEN: so I think they shouldn't be angry.

fullTextZH: 好，那我在大学的时候，
fullTextEN: Okay, when I was in college,

fullTextZH: 我的专业（major）是日语，
fullTextEN: my major was Japanese,

fullTextZH: 对，那个时候，我学习日语。
fullTextEN: Yes, at that time, I studied Japanese.

fullTextZH: 那我有很多日语的老师，
fullTextEN: I had many Japanese teachers,

fullTextZH: 有的很好，
fullTextEN: some were very good,

fullTextZH: 有的照本宣科，
fullTextEN: some just followed the book.

fullTextZH: 就是书上说什么，他就说什么。
fullTextEN: Whatever the book says, he says.

fullTextZH: 嗯，然后呢，有的老师就是非常不好。
fullTextEN: Um, and then, some teachers are really bad.

fullTextZH: 然后呢，
fullTextEN: And then,

fullTextZH: 有一个老师，我觉得他非常、非常糟糕。
fullTextEN: There was a teacher, I thought he was very, very terrible.

fullTextZH: 他是我的语法老师，就是他教我们语法。
fullTextEN: He was my grammar teacher, he taught us grammar.

fullTextZH: 然后，我记得，
fullTextEN: Then, I remember,

fullTextZH: 那个时候，他有一本语法的书，
fullTextEN: At that time, he had a grammar book,

fullTextZH: 那我们都没有。
fullTextEN: which we all didn't have.

fullTextZH: 所以呢，他就把这本书扫描、扫描，
fullTextEN: So, he scanned the book,

fullTextZH: 然后放在屏幕上，
fullTextEN: and then put it on the screen,

fullTextZH: 那我们所有的人都可以看到。
fullTextEN: so we all could see it.

fullTextZH: 那为什么我觉得他是一个
fullTextEN: So why do I think he is a

fullTextZH: 非常糟糕的老师呢？
fullTextEN: very terrible teacher?

fullTextZH: 因为第一个，他完全没有准备，
fullTextEN: Because first, he was completely unprepared,

fullTextZH: 他真的就是书上说什么，他就读什么。
fullTextEN: he really just read whatever the book said.

fullTextZH: 然后第二个，
fullTextEN: And second,

fullTextZH: 他的扫描扫得很不好，
fullTextEN: his scanning was very poor,

fullTextZH: 我觉得如果我们看，应该这样看，
fullTextEN: I think if we look, we should look like this,

fullTextZH: 但是因为他扫描、扫描得不好，
fullTextEN: but because he scanned poorly,

fullTextZH: 我们都是这样看，
fullTextEN: we all looked like this,

fullTextZH: 所有的东西都是歪的。
fullTextEN: Everything is crooked.

fullTextZH: 对，所以我觉得很生气，
fullTextEN: Yes, so I feel very angry,

fullTextZH: 我觉得这个老师真的是一个
fullTextEN: I think this teacher really is a

fullTextZH: 很不负责的（irresponsible）老师，
fullTextEN: very irresponsible teacher,

fullTextZH: 很糟糕的老师，
fullTextEN: very bad teacher,

fullTextZH: 课也上得不好，
fullTextEN: The class is also not well taught,

fullTextZH: 然后也没有准备。
fullTextEN: and also not prepared.

fullTextZH: 我对他非常、非常不满意。
fullTextEN: I am very, very dissatisfied with him.

fullTextZH: 而且，那个时候，我也去上很多别的课，
fullTextEN: Moreover, at that time, I also attended many other classes,

fullTextZH: 我很喜欢学英语，
fullTextEN: I really like learning English,

fullTextZH: 我很喜欢学习中文。
fullTextEN: I really like learning Chinese.

fullTextZH: 所以，我去上英语老师的课，
fullTextEN: So, I attended the English teacher's class,

fullTextZH: 中文老师的课，
fullTextEN: the Chinese teacher's class,

fullTextZH: 然后，我发现有一个英语老师，
fullTextEN: Then, I found there was an English teacher,

fullTextZH: 他也是教语法，
fullTextEN: he also teaches grammar,

fullTextZH: 但是他是一个很好、很好的老师。
fullTextEN: but he is a very, very good teacher.

fullTextZH: 他会每次准备很短的片段让我们听
fullTextEN: He would prepare very short clips for us to listen to

fullTextZH: 这个语法点，
fullTextEN: this grammar point,

fullTextZH: 所以我觉得他非常地认真，
fullTextEN: so I think he is very serious,

fullTextZH: 他花很多、很多的时间准备课。
fullTextEN: he spends a lot, a lot of time preparing classes.

fullTextZH: 那因为我有一个不好的日语老师，
fullTextEN: That's because I have a bad Japanese teacher,

fullTextZH: 有一个很好的英语老师，
fullTextEN: I have a very good English teacher,

fullTextZH: 我就可以比较，
fullTextEN: so I can compare,

fullTextZH: 然后我就觉得，
fullTextEN: then I feel,

fullTextZH: 这个日语老师真的很糟糕。
fullTextEN: this Japanese teacher is really terrible.

fullTextZH: 所以呢，我也不想去上课。
fullTextEN: So, I don't want to attend class.

fullTextZH: 当然，我不想去上课，还有一个原因，
fullTextEN: Of course, I don't want to attend class for another reason,

fullTextZH: 是因为他的课是1点半，
fullTextEN: it's because his class is at 1:30,

fullTextZH: 然后，那个时候很困、很困，我很想睡觉，
fullTextEN: and at that time I'm very sleepy, very sleepy, I really want to sleep,

fullTextZH: 我不想去上他的课。
fullTextEN: I don't want to attend his class.

fullTextZH: 但是在我的学校，
fullTextEN: But at my school,

fullTextZH: 如果老师发现你有
fullTextEN: if the teacher finds out you have

fullTextZH: 3次以上没有来上课，
fullTextEN: missed class more than 3 times,

fullTextZH: 那他会让你
fullTextEN: then he will make you

fullTextZH: 挂科（to fail the subject），挂科就是没有通过，
fullTextEN: fail the subject, failing means not passing,

fullTextZH: 你必须要再学一年，然后再考一次。
fullTextEN: you must study for another year and then take the exam again.

fullTextZH: 好，我不想要挂科，
fullTextEN: Okay, I don't want to fail,

fullTextZH: 可是我也不想去上课，
fullTextEN: but I also don't want to attend class,

fullTextZH: 因为我更想去睡觉。
fullTextEN: because I want to sleep more.

fullTextZH: 所以，我给这个老师发短信，
fullTextEN: So, I sent a text to this teacher,

fullTextZH: 我说：“老师，你好，
fullTextEN: I said, 'Hello, teacher,'

fullTextZH: 我觉得你没有备课，
fullTextEN: I think you didn't prepare for class,

fullTextZH: 所以我不想再来上你的课了。”
fullTextEN: so I don't want to attend your class anymore.

fullTextZH: 那你觉得，我的老师说了什么？
fullTextEN: So what do you think my teacher said?

fullTextZH: 他说明白了，没有问题。
fullTextEN: He said he understood, no problem.

fullTextZH: 所以，那一整个学期（semester），我都没有去上课，
fullTextEN: So, that whole semester, I didn't attend class,

fullTextZH: 我都在我的宿舍里（dorm）睡觉。
fullTextEN: I slept in my dorm.

fullTextZH: 这个老师，他可以让我挂科，但是他没有，
fullTextEN: This teacher, he could have failed me, but he didn't,

fullTextZH: 可能他也觉得啊，是他的问题，
fullTextEN: Maybe he also thought, ah, it was his problem,

fullTextZH: 因为他没有备课。
fullTextEN: because he didn't prepare for class.

fullTextZH: 然后，最后，我觉得我考了70多（out of 100），
fullTextEN: Then, in the end, I think I scored over 70 (out of 100),

fullTextZH: 当然不多，但是我也不在乎，
fullTextEN: Of course, it's not much, but I don't care,

fullTextZH: 因为我觉得，对我来说，分数不是很重要。
fullTextEN: because I think, for me, grades aren't very important.

fullTextZH: 重要的是我可以睡觉，
fullTextEN: What's important is that I can sleep,

fullTextZH: 然后，更重要的是，
fullTextEN: and more importantly,

fullTextZH: 我可以去听我觉得更有意思的课。
fullTextEN: I can attend classes I find more interesting.

fullTextZH: 所以，那个时候，
fullTextEN: So, at that time,

fullTextZH: 我听了很多、很多的英语课和中文课，
fullTextEN: I attended many, many English and Chinese classes,

fullTextZH: 所以我的英语和中文，
fullTextEN: so my English and Chinese,

fullTextZH: 比我的日语要好很多、很多。
fullTextEN: are much, much better than my Japanese.

fullTextZH: 现在，我自己是老师，
fullTextEN: Now, I am a teacher myself,

fullTextZH: 所以我常常反省（to reflect），
fullTextEN: So I often reflect,

fullTextZH: 嗯，如果有时候我做得不好，
fullTextEN: Hmm, if sometimes I don't do well,

fullTextZH: 那我应该做得更好。
fullTextEN: Then I should do better.

fullTextZH: 我觉得我小的时候，
fullTextEN: I think when I was young,

fullTextZH: 如果我看到一个不好的老师，
fullTextEN: If I saw a bad teacher,

fullTextZH: 我会直接告诉他。
fullTextEN: I would directly tell them.

fullTextZH: 那现在，我更应该做一个好的老师。
fullTextEN: So now, I should be a better teacher.

fullTextZH: 你呢？你和你的老师有没有什么故事？
fullTextEN: What about you? Do you have any stories with your teachers?

fullTextZH: 你可以留言告诉我！
fullTextEN: You can leave a message and tell me!

fullTextZH: 好，那我们下次见，拜拜！
fullTextEN: Okay, see you next time, bye!
